def VTask.map : {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> (M : Matroid α) -> (f : α → β) -> (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) -> Matroid β :=
  fun (α : Type u_1) (β : Type u_2) (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) =>
    let E : Set β := f '' M.E
    let I : Set (Set β) := {X : Set β | ∃ Y : Set α, M.Indep Y ∧ X = f '' Y}
    let r : ℕ → Set β → ℕ := fun _ X => M.rank (M.E ∩ f ⁻¹' X)
    let r' : Set β → ℕ := fun X => M.rank (M.E ∩ f ⁻¹' X)
    (⟨E, I, r', by
      -- Verify the ground set and independent sets satisfy the required properties
      have h₁ : ∀ (X : Set β), X ∈ I ↔ ∃ (Y : Set α), M.Indep Y ∧ X = f '' Y := by
        intro X
        simp [I]
      have h₂ : ∅ ∈ I := by
        have h₃ : M.Indep ∅ := M.empty_ind
        have h₄ : (∅ : Set β) = f '' (∅ : Set α) := by simp
        have h₅ : ∃ (Y : Set α), M.Indep Y ∧ (∅ : Set β) = f '' Y := by
          refine' ⟨∅, h₃, _⟩
          simp
        simp_all [I]
      have h₃ : ∀ (X Y : Set β), X ∈ I → Y ⊆ X → Y ∈ I := by
        intro X Y hX hY
        simp only [h₁] at hX ⊢
        obtain ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩ := hX
        refine' ⟨Z, hZ, _⟩
        have h₄ : f '' Z ∩ Y ⊆ f '' Z := by
          intro x hx
          simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hx ⊢
          tauto
        have h₅ : f '' Z ∩ Y = f '' (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' Y) := by
          ext x
          simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage]
          <;>
          (try aesop) <;>
          (try
            {
              constructor <;> intro h <;>
              (try { obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := h <;> refine' ⟨y, _, _⟩ <;> aesop }) <;>
              (try { aesop })
            }) <;>
          (try
            {
              aesop
            })
        have h₆ : f '' (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' Y) ⊆ f '' Z := by
          apply Set.image_subset_of_subset
          apply Set.inter_subset_left
        have h₇ : f '' (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' Y) ⊆ f '' Z := by
          apply Set.image_subset_of_subset
          apply Set.inter_subset_left
        simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
        <;>
        (try aesop) <;>
        (try
          {
            simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
            <;>
            aesop
          })
      have h₄ : ∀ (X Y : Set β), X ∈ I → Y ∈ I → X ∪ Y ∈ I := by
        intro X Y hX hY
        simp only [h₁] at hX hY ⊢
        obtain ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩ := hX
        obtain ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩ := hY
        refine' ⟨Z ∪ W, M.union_ind hZ hW, _⟩
        have h₅ : f '' (Z ∪ W) = f '' Z ∪ f '' W := by
          simp [Set.image_union]
        simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
        <;>
        (try aesop) <;>
        (try
          {
            simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
            <;>
            aesop
          })
      have h₅ : ∀ (X : Set β) (s : Finset β), X ∈ I → s ⊆ X → s ∈ I := by
        intro X s hX hs
        simp only [h₁] at hX ⊢
        obtain ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩ := hX
        refine' ⟨Z, hZ, _⟩
        have h₆ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' Z := by
          exact hs
        have h₇ : (s : Set β) = f '' (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) := by
          have h₈ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' Z := h₆
          have h₉ : (s : Set β) = f '' (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) := by
            apply Set.ext
            intro x
            simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_image]
            <;>
            (try aesop) <;>
            (try
              {
                constructor <;> intro h <;>
                (try { aesop }) <;>
                (try { refine' ⟨x, by aesop, by aesop⟩ }) <;>
                (try { aesop })
              })
          exact h₉
        have h₈ : (s : Set β) = f '' (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) := h₇
        have h₉ : f ⁻¹' (s : Set β) ⊆ Z := by
          intro x hx
          have h₁₀ : f x ∈ (s : Set β) := by
            simp_all [Set.mem_preimage]
          have h₁₁ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' Z := h₆
          have h₁₂ : f x ∈ f '' Z := h₁₁ h₁₀
          obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := h₁₂
          have h₁₃ : f y = f x := by simp_all
          have h₁₄ : y ∈ Z := by simp_all
          have h₁₅ : x ∈ Z := by
            have h₁₆ : f y = f x := by simp_all
            have h₁₇ : y ∈ M.E := by
              have h₁₈ : y ∈ Z := by simp_all
              have h₁₉ : Z ⊆ M.E := by
                have h₂₀ : M.Indep Z := hZ
                exact h₂₀.subset
              exact h₁₉ h₁₈
            have h₂₀ : x ∈ M.E := by
              have h₂₁ : f x ∈ (s : Set β) := by simp_all [Set.mem_preimage]
              have h₂₂ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' Z := h₆
              have h₂₃ : f x ∈ f '' Z := h₂₂ h₂₁
              obtain ⟨y', hy', hy''⟩ := h₂₃
              have h₂₄ : y' ∈ Z := by simp_all
              have h₂₅ : y' ∈ M.E := by
                have h₂₆ : M.Indep Z := hZ
                exact h₂₆.subset h₂₄
              have h₂₆ : x ∈ M.E := by
                by_contra h
                have h₂₇ : x ∉ M.E := h
                simp_all [Set.mem_preimage]
                <;>
                (try aesop)
              exact h₂₆
            have h₂₁ : y ∈ M.E := by
              have h₂₂ : y ∈ Z := by simp_all
              have h₂₃ : Z ⊆ M.E := by
                have h₂₄ : M.Indep Z := hZ
                exact h₂₄.subset
              exact h₂₃ h₂₂
            have h₂₂ : f y = f x := by simp_all
            have h₂₃ : y = x := by
              have h₂₄ : f y = f x := by simp_all
              have h₂₅ : y ∈ M.E := by simp_all
              have h₂₆ : x ∈ M.E := by simp_all
              have h₂₇ : Set.InjOn f M.E := hf
              have h₂₈ : y ∈ M.E := by simp_all
              have h₂₉ : x ∈ M.E := by simp_all
              have h₃₀ : f y = f x := by simp_all
              have h₃₁ : y = x := h₂₇ h₂₈ h₂₉ h₃₀
              exact h₃₁
            simp_all
          simp_all
        have h₁₀ : f ⁻¹' (s : Set β) ⊆ Z := h₉
        have h₁₁ : f '' (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) ⊆ f '' Z := by
          apply Set.image_subset_of_subset h₁₀
        have h₁₂ : (s : Set β) = f '' (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) := h₈
        have h₁₃ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' Z := by
          rw [h₁₂]
          exact h₁₁
        simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
        <;>
        (try aesop)
      have h₆ : ∀ (s : Finset β), s ⊆ E → s ∈ I := by
        intro s hs
        have h₇ : (s : Set β) ⊆ E := by exact_mod_cast hs
        have h₈ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' M.E := by
          simpa [E] using h₇
        have h₉ : ∃ (Z : Set α), M.Indep Z ∧ (s : Set β) = f '' Z := by
          have h₁₀ : (s : Set β) ⊆ f '' M.E := h₈
          have h₁₁ : ∃ (Z : Set α), (s : Set β) = f '' Z ∧ Z ⊆ M.E := by
            classical
            use (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) ∩ M.E
            constructor
            ·
              have h₁₂ : (s : Set β) = f '' ((f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) ∩ M.E) := by
                apply Set.ext
                intro x
                simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
                <;>
                (try aesop) <;>
                (try
                  {
                    constructor <;> intro h <;>
                    (try { aesop }) <;>
                    (try {
                      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := h
                      refine' ⟨y, _⟩ <;>
                      aesop
                    }) <;>
                    (try { aesop })
                  })
              exact h₁₂
            ·
              have h₁₂ : (f ⁻¹' (s : Set β)) ∩ M.E ⊆ M.E := by
                apply Set.inter_subset_right
              exact h₁₂
          obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZ'⟩ := h₁₁
          have h₁₂ : M.Indep Z := by
            have h₁₃ : Z ⊆ M.E := hZ'
            have h₁₄ : M.Indep Z := by
              apply M.subset_ind
              <;> simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
              <;>
              (try aesop)
            exact h₁₄
          refine' ⟨Z, h₁₂, _⟩
          have h₁₃ : (s : Set β) = f '' Z := by
            exact hZ
          exact h₁₃
        obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZ'⟩ := h₉
        simp_all [h₁]
        <;>
        (try aesop)
      -- Prove that the rank function satisfies the required properties
      have h₇ : ∀ (X : Set β), X ∈ I → r' X = 0 := by
        intro X hX
        simp [r']
        <;>
        (try aesop)
      -- Combine all the properties to form the matroid
      simp_all [Set.Subset.trans]
      <;>
      (try aesop)
      ⟩ : Matroid β)
